calendar-view.purpose: Represent scheduled maintenance, renewals, billing, route windows, and operational events with accessible date navigation and recovery states.
useWhen: Users need to scan events by day, week, or month.
Events have status, owner, route, renewal, or maintenance context.
Date navigation affects dashboards, planning, or operational commitments.
doNotUseWithoutReview: A single date selection is enough.
Timezone, event source, recurrence, or ownership is unclear.
Calendar data affects financial, compliance, or legal deadlines without review.
foundations: Defines calendar grid/list density, header controls, and responsive fallback.
Owns date labels, event titles, empty days, and timezone copy.
Controls today, selected, warning, disabled, and event status.
Today, selected, loaded, loading, empty, filtered, warning, and error states are explicit.
Event detail uses Popover/Drawer without hiding calendar context.
Date navigation, event labels, and selected state are text-backed.
variants: Empty State explains no scheduled events.
motion: Popover/Tooltip uses Design System overlay motion.
accessibility: Events are available as text list.
tests: Event detail opens after user action.
Narrow viewport keeps date and events readable.

canDecide: Use Calendar View for scheduled operational events.
Use Date Picker for date anchor and List/Card for events.
Use Empty State for no scheduled items.
mustAsk: Timezone, recurrence, event source, owner, or deadline policy is unclear.
Calendar affects billing, compliance, legal, maintenance, or route commitments.
miel.handoff: Confirm date range, timezone, event source, ownership, recurrence, status, detail action, and empty/error behavior.
